title: Finite ℓ¹ Coboundary Obstructions: Primal–Dual Certificates, Operator-Valued Extensions, and Spectral Comparisons

rights.description: Source code, Lean files, notebooks, and release tooling (LICENSE-CODE).

description: This monograph develops the finite structural properties of L1 coboundary defects on finite posets and directed graphs, together with comparative extensions across Lp and Schatten-p cochain norms. We establish functorial aggregation monotonicity under contractive cochain maps (Theorem 2.1), exact rational Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) primal-dual optimality certificates and capacity-normalized overlapping-cycle holonomy bounds on finite graphs (Theorem 4.2, Proposition 4.6), operator-valued Schatten-p coboundary extensions and telescoping path distinguishability bounds (Theorem 5.1), and a sharp secular-root spectral comparison floor (Proposition E.7e). The package ships exact rational L2 and weighted Chebyshev solvers, high-precision interior-p and Schatten diagnostics, and a Lean 4 verification of the finite integer-list certificate optimality inequality (general_finite_certificate_optimality).
